<function name="SendHint" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sends a hint to a player.

<note>This function is only available in Sandbox and its derivatives. Since this adds `#Hint_` to the beginning of each message, you should only use it with default hint messages, or those cached with <page>language.Add</page>. For hints with custom text, look at <page>notification.AddLegacy</page>.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<file line="119-L127">gamemodes/sandbox/gamemode/player_extension.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="name" type="string">Name/class/index of the hint. You can find a list of hint names for this function <page text="here">List_of_Hint_Classes</page>.</arg>
		<arg name="delay" type="number">Delay in seconds before showing the hint</arg>
	</args>
</function>
